title: Clean-Room Gate Decision
description: A recorded PASS/FAIL decision on whether a specification version is sufficient for independent implementation and free of restricted material, checked before it may cross Zone R -> Zone H via 'cleanroom handoff'. See SKILL.md's 'Mandatory stage: Team A / Team B implementation handover' and references/clean-room-gate.md.

reviewer.description: The human who made this call -- never a tool or agent id; the automated_signal below is evidence for the reviewer, not itself an actor.

automated_signal.description: Deterministic: 'sufficient' iff at least one observable_requirement node is handoff-eligible AND no on-file sanitisation report for a candidate Zone H document is blocked. A low bar, not a claim of spec quality -- see 'sufficiency' for the actual counts.

overrode_automated_signal.description: True only when decision=pass was recorded despite automated_signal=insufficient -- a deliberate human override, never silently conflated with a genuinely sufficient specification.

blocking_sanitisation_reports.description: Filenames under evidence/sanitisation-reports/ that were blocked at the time of this decision.
